query:
SELECT 
  state_code,
  state_name,
  status,
  candidate1_name,
  candidate1_party,
  candidate2_name,
  candidate2_party,
  incumbent,
  incumbent_party,
  race_rating,
  primary_date,
  primary_winner,
  called_winner,
  pct_reporting
FROM senate_races
ORDER BY primary_date, state_code;
